what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: bic(fit, nobs(fit, Y)) at each side's own optimum, ranks d = 1, 2, 3
cases.julia_source: GLLVModels.bic(fit, nobs(fit, Y)), as at test/test_model_comparison.jl:124; fits as at test/test_model_comparison.jl:118
cases.note: Julia fits the fixture's own response matrix (Y_wide) with fit_gaussian_gllvm(Y; X = per-species intercepts, K), K = 1, 2, 3, as in the test; R's values are the recorded P1 gllvmTMB fits of the same data and nested ranks. The test uses this looser tolerance because the two optimisers are independent. The test also asserts nobs equality and dof equality exactly (integers, no tolerance), so those have no numeric case.
